text.id: Siang. Gue nunggu empat jam di warung kopi, minum tiga gelas kopi sachet yang rasanya kayak gula dibakar.
text.en: Noon. I waited four hours at the coffee stall, drinking three cups of instant coffee that tasted like burnt sugar.

text.id: Kapal biru-putih itu ada di ujung dermaga. Ban bekas masih nutupin setengah namanya. Di sebelahnya, seorang bapak duduk di atas ember terbalik, benerin jaring pake jarum kayu.
text.en: The blue and white boat is at the end of the pier. The old tire still hides half its name. Next to it, a man sits on an upturned bucket, mending a net with a wooden needle.

text.id: Pak Hendra?
text.en: Pak Hendra?

text.id: Siapa yang nanya.
text.en: Who's asking.

text.id: Raka. Saya nyari temen saya. Sekar. Dia podcaster, sering ke sini.
text.en: Raka. I'm looking for a friend. Sekar. She does a podcast, she comes here a lot.

text.id: Banyak yang ke sini. Saya nggak hafal muka orang.
text.en: Lots of people come here. I don't remember faces.

text.id: Jarumnya nggak berhenti. Matanya juga nggak naik dari jaring.
text.en: His needle doesn't stop. Neither do his eyes leave the net.

text.id: Kapal ini dulu punya Pak Karta, kan?
text.en: This boat used to be Pak Karta's, right?

text.id: Jarumnya berhenti.
text.en: The needle stops.

text.id: Kamu kenal abang saya dari mana?
text.en: How do you know my brother?

text.id: Setahun lalu, saya harusnya ikut kapal ini. Sabtu, jam setengah enam pagi. Sama Sekar. Saya nggak dateng.
text.en: A year ago, I was supposed to go out on this boat. Saturday, five thirty in the morning. With Sekar. I didn't show up.

text.id: Pak Hendra ngelihat gue lama. Lama banget, sampai gue mulai ngitung ombak yang nabrak tiang dermaga.
text.en: Pak Hendra looks at me for a long time. Long enough that I start counting the waves hitting the pier posts.

text.id: Anak yang nggak dateng.
text.en: The kid who didn't show.

text.id: Abang saya cerita. Anak perempuan itu nunggu di sini sampai mataharinya tinggi. Terus dia tetep ikut, sendirian, rekam semuanya. Pulangnya dia nggak ngomong sepatah kata pun.
text.en: My brother told me. That girl waited here until the sun was high. Then she came out anyway, alone, recorded everything. She didn't say a word the whole way back.

text.id: "Terus kamu mau apa dari saya?" Tunjukkan kenapa lo yakin Sekar ke sini.
text.en: "So what do you want from me?" Show him why you're sure Sekar came here.

text.id: Gue tunjukin foto dari grup. Sekar, jaket hijau, haluan biru-putih di belakangnya. Senin, jam sepuluh kurang tiga belas.
text.en: I show him the photo from the group. Sekar, green jacket, the blue and white bow behind her. Monday, thirteen minutes to ten.

text.id: Banyak kapal biru-putih di sini.
text.en: There are lots of blue and white boats here.

text.id: Yang namanya "Sri Rej" dan nomornya "14" cuma satu, Pak.
text.en: Only one has a name starting "Sri Rej" and a number starting "14", sir.

text.id: Gue tunjukin foto jadwal kapal dari papan gabus Sekar. Jam setengah enam, dilingkarin dua kali.
text.en: I show him the ferry schedule from Sekar's corkboard. Five thirty, circled twice.

text.id: Itu kapal penumpang ke Pari. Bukan kapal saya.
text.en: That's the passenger boat to Pari. Not my boat.

text.id: Kapal Bapak juga berangkat setengah enam. Dari dulu.
text.en: Your boat leaves at five thirty too. It always has.

text.id: Gue tunjukin pesan yang nggak pernah sampai itu. "Ka. Inget jam lima pagi itu? Gue masih di sana."
text.en: I show him the message that never arrived. "Ka. Remember five in the morning? I'm still there."

text.id: Itu bukan buat saya baca. Simpen.
text.en: That's not for me to read. Put it away.

text.id: Dia balik ke jaringnya. Jarumnya gerak lagi, lebih cepet dari tadi.
text.en: He goes back to his net. The needle moves again, faster than before.

text.id: Saya nggak ngerti maksud kamu. Saya nelayan, bukan polisi.
text.en: I don't know what you mean. I'm a fisherman, not a policeman.

text.id: Saya nggak tahu dia di mana.
text.en: I don't know where she is.

text.id: Dia ngomong pelan, satu-satu, kayak orang yang lagi milih kata di atas papan rapuh. Bukan kayak orang yang nggak tahu.
text.en: He says it slowly, one word at a time, like a man choosing where to step on rotten boards. Not like a man who doesn't know.

text.id: Tapi saya kasih tahu satu hal. HP itu.
text.en: But I'll tell you one thing. That phone.

text.id: Dia ngelirik saku gue. Gue nggak pernah bilang soal HP Sekar.
text.en: He glances at my pocket. I never said anything about Sekar's phone.

text.id: Jangan dibawa ke mana-mana. HP bisa dicari. Dan jangan kasih ke siapa pun yang tiba-tiba baik sama kamu.
text.en: Don't carry it everywhere. Phones can be tracked. And don't hand it to anyone who's suddenly nice to you.

text.id: Pak. Kalau Bapak tahu sesuatu...
text.en: Sir. If you know something...

text.id: Pulang. Jaga adiknya.
text.en: Go home. Look after her sister.

text.id: Pulang, Mas. Di sini panas.
text.en: Go home. It's hot out here.

text.id: Dia berdiri, ngangkat jaringnya, dan naik ke kapal. Ban bekas di haluannya bergoyang sedikit.
text.en: He stands, lifts his net and climbs onto the boat. The old tire on its bow sways a little.

text.id: Di belakang ban itu, sekarang gue bisa baca semuanya. "SRI REJEKI. No. 1427."
text.en: Behind the tire, now I can read the whole thing. "SRI REJEKI. No. 1427."

text.id: HP gue bunyi. Bukan HP Sekar. HP gue sendiri.
text.en: My phone rings. Not Sekar's. My own.
